description.value: The Quadra Island Farmers Market & Bazaar is a seasonal outdoor market held beside Cafe Aroma, drawing together local vendors selling produce and artisan goods. It serves as a lively community hub and occasionally hosts live music events alongside the stalls. For touring cyclists visiting Quadra Island, it's a convenient stop to pick up local food and experience island community life.

address.value: 657 Harper Rd, Quathiaski Cove, BC V0P 1N0, Canada
